text.title: Asset Rich
text.declared_genre: Alternative Hip-Hop / Acoustic Folk / Spoken Word
text.declared_key: D minor, lifting toward F major in the final hook
text.declared_mood: Witty, class-conscious, tired, quietly proud -> tender, defiant, grateful, resolved
text.production_notes: Fingerpicked acoustic guitar with percussive folk-hop groove, lo-fi drums with soft kick, brushed snare and hand taps, warm upright bass, faint room hiss, subtle till beep and coin sounds low in the mix, hard dropouts before punchlines, sparse piano after second hook, final third adds soft harmonies and fuller bass while staying raw and uncluttered
text.vocal_notes: Intimate male close-mic vocal, spoken-word rap verses with dry British comic timing and clipped pauses, half-sung folk hook, slight rasp on vulnerable lines, whispered doubles on "asset rich" and "cash poor", final hook warmer and communal
section_names: Intro - spoken | dry, close-mic | sparse guitar
Verse 1 - spoken rap | light guitar groove
Verse 2 - spoken rap | brushed snare enters
Verse 3 - warmer spoken rap | piano enters lightly
Final Hook - warm, communal, gently triumphant

transcription.text: My bank had passed if I wanted. Financial insights, bold. I said, mate, I've got insights. What I need is money. I'm asset rich in cash poor, which means I can explain the entire machine. I'm standing in the kitchen, calculating the cheese. I've got skills like emergency candles, bright useful, mostly used when something is failed. I know how to fix three broken systems, four sad people, and one router by threat, and then it gently I can write the email that makes the room behave. I can read the silence in a meeting in here, who is about to quit. I can turn a wound into a chorus, a panic attack, into a plan, a cheap guitar, into a small republic for the overdrawn. Still, the boiler blinks like a moral question, the rent arise with this little crown on. The fridge contains mustard light and the idea of dinner. I count what I know, when the numbers don't line, golden my head, and dust in my hand. I'm asset rich, cash poor, still holding the door, got a fortune in nerve, and a bill on the floor. Made through class roof, with the weather coming through, I own what I learned. But the bank owns the view, if wisdom paid rent, I'd be hard to ignore, but I'm asset rich, cash poor, diversified portfolio, one useful brain, three mugs, and a cardigan with leadership potential. They told us knowledge was allowed to climb and earn it be clever, so my climb till my hands went numb, but a nice little view of everyone below me, also climbing, also renting, also one bad month from becoming a cautionary linked in post-app. I did the courses, read the books, learn the language of rooms or glass walls, stay cold, a pipeline, resilience, tiny spell words for people who were tired, but laminated. And yes, I'm comfortable, comparatively, I've got heeding most days, a dentist, I avoid for emotional reasons and coffee, that cost enough to have opinions, so I won't pretend I'm at the bottom, I'm just close enough to hear it breathing, close enough to know the floor, it's not a floor, it's a subscription, am I set rich, cash poor still holding the door, I've got a fortune in a van, a bill on the floor, it look like a roof with the weather coming through, I own what I learned, but the bank owns the view, if wisdom paid rent, I'd be hard to ignore, but I'm a set rich, cash poor, and the cruel joke is, I do feel rich, not always, not when the car makes a sound like a bag of color would be enjudged, not when the invoice sits in my inbox with its shoes on, but sometimes when a friend says, how did you know what I meant? When a line arrives clean and true after weeks of scraping fuck, when I fix something with patience instead of panic, when the small room fills with people who trust me enough to be tired, then I feel rich, disgustingly rich, I'm sure I count in the sole private island if not giving up, and no, that does not pay the council tax, I have checked repeatedly, but it means the ledger is incomplete, it means the market is terrible, eyesight, it means some forms of wealth, refused to behave like wealth, maybe that's the trick at the end of the album, not pretending broke as holy, not calling pressure character, because someone rich needs the story tidy, but refusing to let the till name every treasurer I have been porting cash and obscene in questions, then in savings, ever with songs, one foot in the middle class, one foot over the drop door, both hands full of things I couldn't sell without becoming less alive, so let the spreadsheet shake its head, let me out for insights, let the landlord call it passive income, like my boss is an active expense, I am still here, still learning, still useful, still making soup, from weather and wider, my set rich cash pours still hold in the door, got a fortune in nerve and a bill on the floor, made the class roof with the weather coming through our own, what I learned, but the bank owns the view with wisdom paid rent, I'd be hard to ignore, but I'm our set rich, cash pour, I'm dead to wear hope, so I'm still singing for more, got a heart in the red and a light in the store, if love had a wage, we'd all make it through, so I count what is left and I share it with you, my bank app says I'm spending too much on groceries fare, but tonight, there are four people at my table, laughing, like the rent can't hear a sin for once, the numbers can't wait outside, hmmm.
